products.notes_quote: "Exotic rosewood and cardamom give way to a smoky blend of precious oud notes, sandalwood and vetiver. Tonka bean and amber add warmth and sensuality." Note list: Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Patchouli, Amber, Oud, Tonka Bean.
products.store_mismatch: Base Note's own note breakdown puts 'Agarwood (Oud)' in the Top Notes alongside amber; Tom Ford's official copy places oud in the second (smoky/heart) phase after the rosewood-cardamom opening, not at the top. Official copy also names patchouli, which Base Note's listing omits entirely.
products.character: A cardamom-and-rosewood opening that resolves into a polished, smoky oud-sandalwood-vetiver core, closed out with tonka and amber so the oud reads warm rather than raw.
products.rung_reason: Official copy explicitly frames this as oud 'polished' for a mainstream customer and buffers it on both sides (rosewood/cardamom opening, tonka/amber close) rather than letting it stand alone up front — matches Base Note's own 'gentle introduction to oud' framing (blog-post-51).

products.notes_quote: Top Notes: Apple, Cinnamon, Lavender, Rosewood. Heart Notes: Cedarwood, Lily of the Valley, Bulgarian Rose. Base Notes: Amber, Laotian Oud, Musk, Sandalwood, Vanilla.
products.store_mismatch: Base Note's top notes ('Lavender, Bulgarian Rose, Cardamom, Cumin') don't match Xerjoff's official top notes ('Apple, Cinnamon, Lavender, Rosewood') — Bulgarian Rose is an official heart note, not a top note, and apple/cinnamon/rosewood are missing from Base Note's list.
products.character: Spiced, fruited lavender opening over a rose-cedar heart, settling into a dense, resinous amber-oud-sandalwood base that Xerjoff itself calls the 'classic Arabian perfumery accord of rose and oud.'
products.rung_reason: Oud anchors a heavy five-note base (amber, Laotian oud, musk, sandalwood, vanilla) built for maximum density — official brand language and Base Note's own 'ceremony, not subtle' description agree this is oud pushed forward, not backgrounded.

products.notes_quote: Notes: Pear, Quince, Black Currant, Violet Leaves, Oud Accord, Rose, Amber, Vanilla. Top: Pear, Quince, Blackcurrant. Heart: Violet Leaves, Oud Accord, Orris, Rose. Base: Amber, Sandalwood, Vanilla.
products.store_mismatch: Base Note's heart notes ('Rose, Oud Accord, Violet Leaves, Orris') and top notes match Bond No. 9's official list closely (only the internal ordering differs) — no material contradiction.
products.character: Fruity pear-quince opening giving way to a rose-and-violet-leaf heart carrying a deliberately sweetened, 'Americanized' oud accord, finished on amber, sandalwood and vanilla.
products.rung_reason: Bond No. 9's own copy says the oud accord was built 'richer and sweeter than the traditional Middle Eastern material' specifically to feel modern rather than reverent — it's layered into the heart with fruit and rose rather than left to dominate.

products.notes_quote: Top Notes: Bergamot, Pink Peppercorn. Heart Notes: Saffron, Praline, Lavender, Clary Sage. Base Notes: Oud, Patchouli, Vetiver, Leather.
products.store_mismatch: None found — Base Note's top notes (Bergamot, Pink Peppercorn) and base notes (Oud, Patchouli, Vetiver, Leather) match Parfums de Marly's official listing exactly.
products.character: A cold, sharp bergamot-pepper opening warming through a saffron-praline heart before settling into a dark, smoky oud-leather-patchouli base built for winter nights.
products.rung_reason: Oud sits in a four-note base with patchouli, vetiver and leather with no vanilla or sweetness to soften it, and the brand's own copy describes the drydown as 'intensifying into oud depth' — dark and smoky by design.

products.notes_quote: Direct fetch returned HTTP 403 (bulgari.com blocks both WebFetch and curl with a browser user-agent). Reconstructed from Google's indexed content of the same official URL: Top Notes: Vanilla bourbon, Cedarwood. Heart Notes: Benzoin Siam, Blonde suede. Base Notes: Oud Assam, Sandalwood. Brand copy: 'vanilla bourbon caviar absolute intertwined with precious oud assam essence.'
products.store_mismatch: Base Note's single-note-per-stage listing (Top: Bourbon Vanilla / Heart: Siam Benzoin / Base: Agarwood (Oud)) is a simplified subset of Bulgari's official list — it omits cedarwood, blonde suede and sandalwood, but does not contradict the official notes; oud is base-note in both.
products.character: A vanilla-caviar opening over a benzoin-and-suede heart, with oud assam and sandalwood underneath as structure rather than the headline note.
products.rung_reason: Bulgari leads its own copy with vanilla bourbon and the labradorite/vanilla-caviar concept; oud assam is named as one of two base notes providing depth, not the note the fragrance is built to showcase — consistent with Base Note's own vanilla-colognes post calling it 'vanilla with leather and oud.'
